condition_a_lane_a_runtime_evidence.prerequisite: Lane A runtime evidence produced under contract and audited

condition_b_lane_b_pre_review_complete.prerequisite: Lane B Batch 03 readiness ledger pre-reviewed and accepted by Councils

condition_c_council_risk_recommendation.prerequisite: Comprehensive risk analysis and recommendation submitted by Council

risk_evaluation.continued_hard_freeze_risks: Eliminates supply intake, stalls student community value delivery, and postpones validation of clean intake pipelines.
risk_evaluation.scoped_unfreeze_risks: Potential risk of unvetted candidate data intake if containment gates fail.
risk_evaluation.risk_mitigation_strategy: Strict isolation of intake worker to pre-reviewed non-commercial proposals; Catalog Builder, Staging index, and Production DOM remain strictly locked.
risk_evaluation.blast_radius_containment: Micro-Batch 02 and Cohort 15 (COHORT_EZ_AM_15) remain permanently blocked by remediation overlay (CLOSED_CONTAMINATION_SHARED_RAW). Zero contamination leakage possible.
risk_evaluation.council_verdict: The Council unanimously advises that a strictly scoped, conditional unfreeze limited to preparatory evidence collection for verified civic proposals is technically manageable and safe, subject to explicit CEO authorization.

condition_d_scope_path_rollback_observab.prerequisite: Explicit boundaries for scope, target paths, rollback mechanisms, and observability

scoped_boundaries.allowed_scope: Candidate intake worker execution for proposals within BATCH_03_READINESS_LEDGER only
scoped_boundaries.disallowed_scope: Catalog building, HTML rendering, deployment mutations, commercial deal approvals, voucher creation, or public DOM edits

rollback_mechanism.data_purging_rule: Immediate removal of any staged candidate evidence in the event of anomaly

observability_framework.dom_leakage_detection: Puppeteer headless check on staging preview (port 4173) asserts exactly 1 approved GitHub card and 0 Batch 02/03 cards

governance_conclusion.authority_reservation: The Council emphasizes that this document is purely an advisory risk evaluation. It does NOT constitute an unfreeze order, does NOT authorize the opening of Batch 03, and does NOT alter existing platform locks. Sole authority resides with the CEO.
